title: OpenLint Ruleset
description: An OpenLint ruleset: a set of rules applied to JSON or YAML documents. This schema describes the format as written in JSON or YAML. The specification is at https://spec.openlint.org/.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the ruleset checks.

documentationUrl.description: URL to documentation for this ruleset. A rule that declares no documentationUrl of its own reports this URL followed by `#` and the rule name.

formats.description: Document formats this ruleset applies to. Acts as the default for every rule that does not declare its own formats. When omitted, rules apply to every document.

extends.description: Other rulesets this ruleset inherits from.

rules.description: Maps a rule name to a Rule Object, or to a shorthand that adjusts a rule inherited through `extends`. The name appears in results, and an extending ruleset uses it to adjust the rule.

aliases.description: Named, reusable path expressions that rules can reference from `given` with a leading `#`.

overrides.description: File-scoped and pointer-scoped adjustments applied on top of the ruleset.

parserOptions.description: Severities for problems detected while parsing the document itself, before any rule runs.

functions.description: Names of the custom functions the ruleset uses, loaded from `functionsDir`.

functionsDir.description: Directory, relative to the ruleset file, that custom functions named in `functions` are loaded from. Defaults to `functions`.

Severity.title: Severity
Severity.description: How a rule's results are reported. `off` (-1) disables the rule. Defaults to `warn` when unset.

Format.title: Format
Format.description: Identifier of a document format. A format is a predicate that decides whether a given document is of that kind, so a rule scoped to a format only runs against matching documents.

PathExpression.title: Path expression
PathExpression.description: Either a JSONPath expression beginning with `$`, or an alias reference beginning with `#` optionally followed by a JSONPath subset (for example `#Info.description`).

Given.title: Path expression or list
Given.description: The part or parts of the document a rule is applied to. A single path expression, or an array of them.

FunctionInvocation.title: Function invocation
FunctionInvocation.description: What a rule asserts: the function to run against each node `given` matches, and the options it takes.

field.description: Apply the function to part of the matched node: a property name, a path of property names and indices such as `info.contact.email` or `tags[0]`, or a JSONPath expression starting with `$`, evaluated against the matched node. `@key` applies the function to each property key of the matched node.

function.description: Name of a core function (`alphabetical`, `casing`, `defined`, `enumeration`, `falsy`, `length`, `or`, `pattern`, `schema`, `truthy`, `undefined`, `unreferencedReusableObject`, `xor`) or of a custom function declared in `functions`.

functionOptions.description: Options passed to the function. Each function defines the options it accepts.

Then.title: Function invocation or list
Then.description: One function invocation, or an array of them, each applied to every node `given` matches. An empty array asserts nothing.

Rule.title: Rule Object
Rule.description: A rule selects nodes in a document with `given` and checks each selected node with `then`.

description.description: Human-readable statement of what the rule requires.

documentationUrl.description: URL explaining the rule and how to satisfy it. Reported alongside results.

message.description: Template for the reported message. Supports the placeholders `{{error}}`, `{{description}}`, `{{path}}`, `{{property}}`, and `{{value}}`.

severity.description: Severity of this rule's results. Defaults to `warn`.

formats.description: Document formats this rule applies to. Overrides the ruleset-level `formats`.

recommended.description: Whether the rule is enabled when another ruleset extends this one in `recommended` mode. Defaults to true.

resolved.description: Whether the rule runs against the document with `$ref`s resolved (true, the default) or against the document as written (false). Set to false for rules about references themselves.

tags.description: Free-form labels for grouping and filtering rules.

type.description: The kind of rule. `validation` rules assert correctness; `style` rules assert convention.

extensions.description: Metadata for the author's own tooling. A linter ignores it.

RuleOrShorthand.title: Rule Object or shorthand
RuleOrShorthand.description: A Rule Object, or a shorthand that adjusts a rule inherited through `extends`.

Shorthand.title: Shorthand
Shorthand.description: A severity name, or a boolean, where `false` disables the rule and `true` enables it at its current severity.

RulesetReference.title: Ruleset reference
RulesetReference.description: A reference to another ruleset: a built-in identifier (`spectral:oas`, `spectral:asyncapi`, `spectral:arazzo`), a file path, an npm module specifier, or a URL.

RulesetReferenceWithMode.title: Ruleset reference with mode
RulesetReferenceWithMode.description: A ruleset reference and a mode, which decides which of the inherited rules start out enabled: `recommended` (the default), `all`, or `off`. Elements after the mode are ignored.

AliasTarget.title: Alias target
AliasTarget.description: The path expressions an alias resolves to for one set of formats.

formats.description: The formats this target applies to.

given.description: The path expressions the alias resolves to for documents of those formats.

ScopedAlias.title: Scoped alias
ScopedAlias.description: An alias that resolves to different path expressions depending on the format of the document being linted.

targets.description: One set of path expressions per set of formats.

Alias.title: Alias
Alias.description: Either a list of path expressions, or a scoped alias that varies by format.

duplicateKeys.description: Severity for duplicate keys found in the document. Defaults to `error`.

incompatibleValues.description: Severity for a YAML mapping key that is not a string scalar. Defaults to `error`.

Overrides.title: Overrides
Overrides.description: Ordered list of adjustments. Later matching entries win over earlier ones, and every override wins over the base ruleset.

Override.title: Override
Override.description: An adjustment scoped by `files`. A pointer-scoped override, where every glob in `files` carries a JSON Pointer fragment (`path/to/file.yaml#/paths/~1users`), can only change rule severities. A file-scoped override can change anything a ruleset can declare.

Url.title: URL
Url.description: An absolute http, https, or ftp URL whose host is a domain name with a top-level domain of at least two letters, or a public IPv4 address. Host names such as `localhost`, single-label intranet hosts, and private or loopback addresses do not match.
